headline: A Small Team of Specialists
intro: Adventure International is a small team of adventure specialists — destination managers, expedition guides, and adventure outfitters. With guides, leaders, and owners in some of the most incredible locations in the world, living and working in destination countries gives us the ability to deliver exceptional adventures from some of the highest peaks in the Himalaya to the plains of East Africa and the snow-capped summit of Mt Kilimanjaro.
philosophy: Adventure International specializes in adventure travel because we believe in the intrinsic value of traveling to natural environments or remote locations with the specific purpose of active physical participation and exploration of a new sensory experience. Our guiding philosophy is to share this idea with our guests in ways that also improve the welfare of local people.
whyUs: AI is a premier adventure travel specialist with offices in the US, Canada, Holland, East Africa, Peru, and Nepal. We run our own operations in East Africa, the Himalayas, and South America. Our authenticity and expertise comes from our extensive background as guides, trip leaders, and managers — over a decade of experience running safe and professional adventure trips into remote wilderness areas and the world's highest peaks.

testimonial.quote: Adventure International is one of our ideal Partners for Responsible Travel meeting our guidelines for proper porter treatment consistently in all areas. Their commitment to fair and ethical practices, as well as provision of education to their crew, is exemplary.

team.name: Frank Castro
team.bio: Frank grew up in Malibu, California and has spent much of his life traveling and working with management teams on film productions, restaurants, and lodges in Los Angeles, Spain, South Africa, and Tanzania. After managing a leading luxury safari lodge in Tanzania, Frank joined a mountain climbing outfitter as the International Sales & Marketing Director before partnering to found Adventure International. He has climbed Kilimanjaro, Mt Kenya, Mt Meru, and Mt Whitney, among others.

team.name: Ben McCullough
team.bio: Ben is passionate about epic adventures, ethical travel, and sustainable tourism. Born and raised in South West England, he has travelled and worked across South America and East Africa. A qualified Wilderness First Responder with significant high altitude trekking experience, Ben became General Manager of the Tanzanian operation and made Tanzania his home. He has guided groups across the European Alps, the Himalaya, Peru, Ecuador, North Africa, and several East African peaks.

expertisePillars.title: Expert Guides
expertisePillars.body: Elite wilderness first responders with decades of field experience and intimate knowledge of every destination.

expertisePillars.title: Safety First
expertisePillars.body: Rigorous safety protocols, bi-annual training, and comprehensive health monitoring systems on every expedition.

expertisePillars.title: Sustainable Travel
expertisePillars.body: The first company in East Africa to participate in carbon offsets; strict trash-in-trash-out principles throughout.

expertisePillars.title: Local Partnerships
expertisePillars.body: Deep community relationships that create meaningful employment, training, and positive impact in every region.
